extracted.intended_audience: general readers and students of Canadian/Western history; readers interested in the history of the North-West Mounted Police
extracted.subtask_description: A chapter-length historical narrative describing the origin, organization, march, and early operations of the North-West Mounted Police in the 1870s, intended as popular or scholarly history rather than prescriptive guidance. Focuses on events, personalities, logistics, and the social impact of the Force.
